subject: Reminder: complete Data Protection training by 16 Oct
body:
Hi Jordan,

Your annual Data Protection training is due on Fri, Oct 16, 2026. It takes about 20 minutes.

Sign in with your usual company SSO from the Learning portal. If you've already completed it, please ignore this reminder.

Thanks,
People & Culture
